subject.title: fix: forward response-frame meta to clients

question: Should OpenClaw accept optional top-level `res.meta` as an additive Gateway protocol v4 response field in this PR, or require a version-gated or payload-level alternative?
rationale: The patch is a narrow fix for existing dropped metadata, but protocol-envelope compatibility for strict clients is a maintainer-owned upgrade decision that code review cannot safely infer.

options.title: Accept additive v4 metadata
options.body: Resolve the current conflicts, keep the optional `res.meta` schema/docs/Swift/test coverage, and treat strict-client tolerance as the intended v4 compatibility posture.

options.title: Version-gate the field
options.body: Require a protocol-versioned or alternate metadata contract if v4 response envelopes must remain unchanged for strict validators.

options.title: Pause for client-owner signoff
options.body: Hold the PR until Gateway client owners confirm all supported generated/native clients tolerate the new top-level field.

recommendation.title: Accept additive v4 metadata
recommendation.body: Resolve the current conflicts, keep the optional `res.meta` schema/docs/Swift/test coverage, and treat strict-client tolerance as the intended v4 compatibility posture.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the clearest current routing owner from blame and recent gateway/protocol history on the affected schema, responder, and generated-model surfaces.
